name: BlockCypher
tagline: Multi-chain blockchain API for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and more
description: BlockCypher provides REST APIs for multi-chain blockchain data including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, and Dash. Developers can query addresses, transactions, blocks, generate wallets, and receive webhook notifications for chain events.

auth.details: API token via query parameter token= or X-API-Token header; free tier available without token at lower limits

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1,000 requests/day; 100 requests/hour; 3 requests/second; 100 stored webhooks; 100 webhook/WebSocket deliveries/hour; 10 confidence lookups/hour.

rate_limits: Free tier, with or without a token: 3 classic requests/second and 100/hour; pricing also caps usage at 1,000/day. Exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429. Paid tiers have higher limits.
use_cases: get Bitcoin address balance and transaction history
look up a transaction by hash on BTC or ETH
create a webhook for new payments to an address
